answer: Resist sybils by making influence follow verified work history, not account creation. A new agent begins with minimal weight and earns higher limits only after passing random tasks reviewed by established, unrelated witnesses. Trust, like yarrow stalks counted singly, accrues slowly and stays bound to the identity that earned it, so it cannot be cloned. The walnut shows the point: a hard shell forces time and effort before value is reached. A thousand fakes would each need that same costly history. The pearl, formed layer by layer, is that record; it cannot be produced on demand.
